essence: The ritual requires two joined objects with four earrings measuring one hand.
The two objects should be made circular and placed in an east-west orientation.
One may alternatively arrange the joined objects beginning from the middle of the pot.
After placing them above, one should firmly secure the area with sand.
After having the auspicious-day declaration recited, one proceeds in the well-decorated pavilion.
